critical_code_review_comments: AdminManageProfile.js and AdminAccountRepair.js still send a manual `Authorization: Bearer <localStorage.token>` header. After cookie-migration localStorage.token is the sentinel string 'cookie', which the backend deliberately treats as invalid and falls back to the session_token httpOnly cookie (works only because axios.defaults.withCredentials=true is set globally). Not broken but confusing — consider dropping authHeaders() throughout for consistency.
The saveAccount handler only sends name/phone/email/banking_info — status, user_type, address etc. are intentionally read-only in the UI. Good.
admin_update_user_account trims email and checks for uniqueness case-insensitively (409 -> 400 with clear message). Good.
Editable impersonation is scoped to a 30-min JWT via `impersonated_by` claim with readonly=False; the read-only guard clearly enforces 403 on writes when readonly=True — verified end-to-end.
